web <- read_html(url) %>% html_table()
salaries_data <- data.frame(web)
colnames(salaries_data) <- salaries_data[1,]

```{r}
salaries_data$`2024-25` <- gsub("\\$|,", "", salaries_data$`2024-25`)
salaries_data$`2024-25` <- as.numeric(salaries_data$`2024-25`)

pbp_unique_player <- pbp_data %>%
  group_by(Player) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = as.numeric(G), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

pbp_unique_player <- pbp_unique_player %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    true_pos = {
      pos_cols <- c_across(8:12)
      pos_names <- names(pbp_data)[8:12]
      max_index <- which.max(pos_cols)
      sub(".$", "", pos_names[max_index])
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

pbp_unique_player1 <- pbp_unique_player %>% select(Player, Age, true_pos)

salaries1 <- salaries_data %>%
  left_join(pbp_unique_player1, by = c('Player'))

salaries1 <- salaries1[!(is.na(salaries1$true_pos)),]

salaries1$true_pos <- factor(salaries1$true_pos, levels = c("PG", "SG", "SF", "PF", "C"))

ggplot(salaries1, aes(x = true_pos, y = `2024-25`)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
  labs(title = "2024-25 Salaries by Position",
       x = "Position", y = "Salary") +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 50000000)) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = 'bold', size = 18),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = 'bold', size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = 'bold', size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = 'bold', size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10)
  )

age_plot_data <- salaries1 %>%
  group_by(Age) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_salary = mean(`2024-25`, na.rm = TRUE),
    player_count = n()
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(player_count >= 2)

#no lebron
ggplot(age_plot_data, aes(x = Age, y = avg_salary, fill = player_count)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_currency(), position = "left") +
  labs(title = "Average 2024-25 Salary by Age",
       x = "Age",
       y = "Average Salary",
       fill = "# of Players") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = 'bold', size = 18),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = 'bold', size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = 'bold', size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = 'bold')
  )
```

#how shot distance has changed over time
```{r}
shooting_data20_pgs <- shooting_data20 %>%
  mutate(Year = "2019-20") %>%
  filter(str_detect(Pos, "PG"), as.numeric(G) >= 15, as.numeric(MP) >= 200)
shooting_data21_pgs <- shooting_data21 %>%
  mutate(Year = "2020-21") %>%
  filter(str_detect(Pos, "PG"), as.numeric(G) >= 15, as.numeric(MP) >= 200)
shooting_data22_pgs <- shooting_data22 %>%
  mutate(Year = "2021-22") %>%
  filter(str_detect(Pos, "PG"), as.numeric(G) >= 15, as.numeric(MP) >= 200)
shooting_data23_pgs <- shooting_data23 %>%
  mutate(Year = "2022-23") %>%
  filter(str_detect(Pos, "PG"), as.numeric(G) >= 15, as.numeric(MP) >= 200)
shooting_data24_pgs <- shooting_data24 %>%
  mutate(Year = "2023-24") %>%
  filter(str_detect(Pos, "PG"), as.numeric(G) >= 15, as.numeric(MP) >= 200)
shooting_data_pgs <- shooting_data %>%
  mutate(Year = "2024-25") %>%
  filter(str_detect(Pos, "PG"), as.numeric(G) >= 15, as.numeric(MP) >= 200)
all_pg_shooting <- bind_rows(
  shooting_data20_pgs,
  shooting_data21_pgs,
  shooting_data22_pgs,
  shooting_data23_pgs,
  shooting_data24_pgs,
  shooting_data_pgs
)
pgs_yr_summary <- all_pg_shooting %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(avg_dist = mean(as.numeric(`Dist.`), na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(pgs_yr_summary, aes(x = Year, y = avg_dist, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue", size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Average Shot Distance of PGs by Year",
       x = "Season",
       y = "Average Shot Distance") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, face='bold', size=18),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face='bold', size=14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face='bold', size=14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size=10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size=10)
  )

pgs_shot_dist_summary <- all_pg_shooting %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    pct_0_3 = mean(as.numeric(`FGA.0-3`), na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_3_10 = mean(as.numeric(`FGA.3-10`), na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_10_16 = mean(as.numeric(`FGA.10-16`), na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_16_3P = mean(as.numeric(`FGA.16-3P`), na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_3P = mean(as.numeric(`FGA.3P`), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
pgs_long <- pgs_shot_dist_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("pct_"),
    names_to = "ShotZone",
    values_to = "FGA_pct"
  )
pgs_long$ShotZone <- recode(pgs_long$ShotZone,
                            pct_0_3 = "0-3 ft",
                            pct_3_10 = "3-10 ft",
                            pct_10_16 = "10-16 ft",
                            pct_16_3P = "16 ft - 3P",
                            pct_3P = "3P")
pgs_long$ShotZone <- factor(pgs_long$ShotZone,
                            levels = c("0-3 ft", "3-10 ft", "10-16 ft", "16 ft - 3P", "3P"))

ggplot(pgs_long, aes(x = Year, y = FGA_pct, color = ShotZone, group = ShotZone)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Average FGA% by Shot Distance (PGs)",
       x = "Season",
       y = "Average FGA%",
       color = "Shot Distance") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, face='bold', size=18),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face='bold', size=14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face='bold', size=14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size=10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size=10),
    legend.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, face='bold', size=14),
    legend.text = element_text(hjust=0.5, size=10)
  )
```

#evolution of PG salaries
```{r}
salaries_20 <- salaries_20 %>% mutate(Year = "2019-20") %>% rename(Player = player)
salaries_21 <- salaries_21 %>% mutate(Year = "2020-21") %>% rename(Player = player)
salaries_22 <- salaries_22 %>% mutate(Year = "2021-22") %>% rename(Player = player)
salaries_23 <- salaries_23 %>% mutate(Year = "2022-23") %>% rename(Player = player)
salaries_24 <- salaries_24 %>% mutate(Year = "2023-24") %>% rename(Player = player)
salaries_data <- salaries_data %>% mutate(Year = "2024-25")
normalize_names <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(Player = stri_trans_general(Player, "Latin-ASCII"))
}
salaries_20 <- normalize_names(salaries_20)
salaries_21 <- normalize_names(salaries_21)
salaries_22 <- normalize_names(salaries_22)
salaries_23 <- normalize_names(salaries_23)
salaries_24 <- normalize_names(salaries_24)
salaries_data <- normalize_names(salaries_data)
all_pg_shooting <- normalize_names(all_pg_shooting)
salaries_all_yrs <- bind_rows(
  salaries_20 %>% select(Player, Year, salary),
  salaries_21 %>% select(Player, Year, salary),
  salaries_22 %>% select(Player, Year, salary),
  salaries_23 %>% select(Player, Year, salary),
  salaries_24 %>% select(Player, Year, salary),
  salaries_data %>% select(Player, Year, salary=`2024-25`)
)
all_pg_shooting <- all_pg_shooting %>%
  left_join(salaries_all_yrs, by = c("Player", "Year"))
all_pg_shooting_salaries <- all_pg_shooting %>% filter(!is.na(salary))

plot_data <- all_pg_shooting_salaries %>%
  filter(Year != "2024-25")
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Year, y = salary)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue", outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::dollar_format()) +
  labs(
    title = "Point Guard Salaries by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Salary"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = 'bold', size = 18),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = 'bold', size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = 'bold', size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = 'bold')
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 50000000))
```

```{r}
pos_salaries_20 <- salaries_20 %>%
  left_join(shooting_data20 %>% select(Player, Pos), by = "Player") %>%
  select(Player, Pos, Year, salary) %>%
  unique() %>%
  filter(!is.na(Pos))
pos_salaries_21 <- salaries_21 %>%
  left_join(shooting_data21 %>% select(Player, Pos), by = "Player") %>%
  select(Player, Pos, Year, salary) %>%
  unique() %>%
  filter(!is.na(Pos))
pos_salaries_22 <- salaries_22 %>%
  left_join(shooting_data22 %>% select(Player, Pos), by = "Player") %>%
  select(Player, Pos, Year, salary) %>%
  unique() %>%
  filter(!is.na(Pos))
pos_salaries_23 <- salaries_23 %>%
  left_join(shooting_data23 %>% select(Player, Pos), by = "Player") %>%
  select(Player, Pos, Year, salary) %>%
  unique() %>%
  filter(!is.na(Pos))
pos_salaries_24 <- salaries_24 %>%
  left_join(shooting_data24 %>% select(Player, Pos), by = "Player") %>%
  select(Player, Pos, Year, salary) %>%
  unique() %>%
  filter(!is.na(Pos))
pos_salaries_25 <- salaries_data %>%
  left_join(shooting_data %>% select(Player, Pos), by = "Player") %>%
  select(Player, Pos, Year, salary=`2024-25`) %>%
  unique() %>%
  filter(!is.na(Pos))
pos_salaries <- bind_rows(pos_salaries_20, pos_salaries_21, pos_salaries_22, pos_salaries_23, pos_salaries_24, pos_salaries_25)

summary_by_year <- pos_salaries %>%
  group_by(Pos, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_salary = mean(salary, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_salary = median(salary, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr = IQR(salary, na.rm = TRUE),
    variance = var(salary, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_salary = max(salary, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
iqr_trend <- summary_by_year %>%
  select(Pos, Year, iqr) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Year, values_from = iqr) %>%
  nest(IQR_Trend = -Pos)
variance_trend <- summary_by_year %>%
  select(Pos, Year, variance) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Year, values_from = variance) %>%
  nest(Variance_Trend = -Pos)
summary_snapshot <- summary_by_year %>%
  filter(Year %in% c("2019-20", "2024-25")) %>%
  select(Pos, Year, avg_salary, median_salary, max_salary) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Year,
    values_from = c(avg_salary, median_salary, max_salary),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_growth = 100 * (`avg_salary_2024-25` - `avg_salary_2019-20`) / `avg_salary_2019-20`
  )
final_gt_data <- summary_snapshot %>%
  left_join(iqr_trend, by = "Pos") %>%
  left_join(variance_trend, by = "Pos") %>%
  mutate(
    `avg_salary_2024-25` = round(`avg_salary_2024-25` / 1e6,3),
    `median_salary_2024-25` = round(`median_salary_2024-25` / 1e6,3),
    `max_salary_2024-25` = round(`max_salary_2024-25` / 1e6,3)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Pos,
    `avg_salary_2024-25`,
    pct_growth,
    `median_salary_2024-25`,
    IQR_Trend,
    `max_salary_2024-25`,
    Variance_Trend
  )
final_gt_data <- final_gt_data %>%
  mutate(Pos = factor(Pos, levels = c("PG", "SG", "SF", "PF", "C"))) %>%
  arrange(Pos)

title_header <- glue(
  "<div style='display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;'>
    <div style='text-align: left;'>
      <img src='https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/thumb/0/03/National_Basketball_Association_logo.svg/120px-National_Basketball_Association_logo.svg.png' style='height: 70px; width: auto; border-radius: 5px;'>
    </div>
    <div style='text-align: center; flex-grow: 1;'>
      <span style='font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: bold; text-decoration: underline;'>Salary Trends by Position</span><br>
      <span style='font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: bold;'>2019–25</span>
    </div>
  </div>"
)
gt(final_gt_data) %>%
  fmt_currency(columns = c(`avg_salary_2024-25`, `median_salary_2024-25`, `max_salary_2024-25`)) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = pct_growth, decimals = 1, suffixing = TRUE) %>%
  gt_plt_sparkline(IQR_Trend, same_limit = TRUE, type = "default", palette = c('black', 'black','blue','red','black')) %>%
  gt_plt_sparkline(Variance_Trend, same_limit = TRUE, type = "default", palette = c('black', 'black','blue','red','black')) %>%
  cols_label(Pos = "Position", `avg_salary_2024-25` = "Avg Salary", pct_growth = "% Growth", `median_salary_2024-25` = "Median", IQR_Trend = "IQR Trend", `max_salary_2024-25` = "Top Earner", Variance_Trend = "Variance Trend") %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(align = 'center', weight = 'bold', decorate = 'underline'), locations = cells_column_labels()) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(align = 'center', weight = 'bold'), locations = cells_body(columns = c(Pos))) %>%
  tab_footnote(footnote = "in millions (2024-25)", locations = cells_column_labels(columns = c(`avg_salary_2024-25`, `median_salary_2024-25`, `max_salary_2024-25`))) %>%
  tab_footnote(footnote = "2019-24", locations = cells_column_labels(columns = c(pct_growth))) %>%
  gt_add_divider(Pos, weight = px(1.5)) %>%
  gt_add_divider(columns = c(`avg_salary_2024-25`,pct_growth,`median_salary_2024-25`,IQR_Trend,`max_salary_2024-25`,Variance_Trend), weight = px(0.5)) %>%
  tab_header(title = html(title_header))
```


```{r}
corr_data <- all_pg_shooting_salaries %>%
  mutate(log_salary = log(salary)) %>%
  select(log_salary, all_of(names(.)[9:24]), all_of(names(.)[27:28])) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))
cor_results <- sapply(corr_data[-1], function(x) cor(x, corr_data$log_salary, use = "complete.obs"))
cor_df <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(cor_results),
  Correlation = round(cor_results, 3)
) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(Correlation)))

cor_heatmap <- cor_df %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = recode(Variable,
      "FG." = "FG%",
      "FG.3.10" = "FG% (3-10 ft)",
      "FG.2p" = "FG% (2PT)",
      "FG.0.3" = "FG% (0-3 ft)",
      "FG.3P" = "FG% (3PT)",
      "FGA.10.16" = "FGA% (10-16 ft)",
      "Corner3P." = "Corner 3PT%",
      "FGA.16.3P" = "FGA% (16ft–3PT)",
      "FG.10.16" = "FG% (10-16 ft)",
      "FGA.2p" = "FGA% (2PT)",
      "FG.16.3P" = "FG% (16ft–3PT)",
      "FGA.3.10" = "FGA% (3-10 ft)",
      "Dist." = "Avg Shot Dist",
      "FGA.0.3" = "FGA% (0-3 ft)",
      "FGA.3P" = "FGA% (3PT)",
      "FG.2P_ast" = "%Assisted 2PT",
      "Corner3PA." = "Corner 3PA%",
      "FG.3P_ast" = "%Assisted 3PT"
    )
  )
cor_heatmap <- cor_heatmap %>%
  mutate(Variable = factor(Variable, levels = Variable[order(Correlation)]))
ggplot(cor_heatmap, aes(x = "", y = Variable, fill = Correlation)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Correlation), color = "black", fontface = 'bold') +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "red", mid = "white", high = "blue", midpoint = 0) +
  labs(title = "Correlation with Salary", 
       subtitle = "Each value represents the correlation strength (r) between the metric and log(salary)",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = 'bold', size = 18),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = 'bold', size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = 'bold'),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = 'italic', size = 12))
```

```{r}
joined_pg_data <- all_pg_advanced_salaries %>%
  select(Player, Year, USG. = USG., TS. = TS., AST. = AST., FTr = FTr, DRB. = DRB.) %>%
  left_join(
    all_pg_shooting_salaries %>%
      select(Player, Year, FG. = `FG%`, `FG.3.10` = `FG.3-10`, FG.2p = FG.2p,
             `Corner3PA.` = Corner3PA., `FG.3P_ast` = FG.3P_ast),
    by = c("Player", "Year")
  ) %>%
  unique() %>%
  mutate(across(3:12, ~ as.numeric(.)), .keep = "all") %>%
  mutate(
    TS. = TS.*100,
    FTr = FTr*100,
    FG. = FG.*100,
    FG.3.10 = FG.3.10*100,
    FG.2p = FG.2p*100,
    Corner3PA. = Corner3PA.*100,
    FG.3P_ast = FG.3P_ast*100
  )

selected_stats <- c("FG.", "FG.3.10", "FG.2p", "Corner3PA.", "FG.3P_ast",
                    "USG.", "TS.", "AST.", "FTr", "DRB.")
pg_long <- joined_pg_data %>%
  select(Player, Year, all_of(selected_stats)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(Player, Year), names_to = "Stat", values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(Value = as.numeric(Value))
pg_summary <- pg_long %>%
  group_by(Stat, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR = IQR(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dist = list(Value[Year == "2024-25"]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
wide_summary <- pg_summary %>%
  group_by(Stat) %>%
  summarise(
    `2019-20 Avg` = round(Mean[Year == "2019-20"],1),
    `2024-25 Avg` = round(Mean[Year == "2024-25"],1),
    `Overall Std. Dev` = round(sd(Mean, na.rm = TRUE),2),
    `Avg % Increase Per Year` = round(((Mean[Year == "2024-25"] - Mean[Year == "2019-20"]) /
                                Mean[Year == "2019-20"] / (length(unique(pg_summary$Year)) - 1))*100,2),
    `IQR Trend` = list(IQR),
    `Std. Dev % Increase` = round(((SD[Year == "2024-25"] - SD[Year == "2019-20"]) / SD[Year == "2019-20"])*100,1),
    `SD Trend` = list(SD),
    `2024-25 Distribution` = pg_summary$Dist[pg_summary$Year == "2024-25" & pg_summary$Stat == unique(Stat)],
    .groups = "drop"
  )
wide_summary <- wide_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Stat = recode(Stat,
      "FG." = "FG%",
      "FG.3.10" = "FG% (3-10 ft)",
      "FG.2p" = "FG% (2PT)",
      "Corner3PA." = "Corner 3PA%",
      "FG.3P_ast" = "%Assisted 3PT",
      "USG." = "USG%",
      "TS." = "TS%",
      "AST." = "AST%",
      "FTr" = "FTAr",
      "DRB." = "DRB%"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Stat)

title_header <- glue(
  "<div style='display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;'>
    <div style='text-align: left;'>
      <img src='https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/thumb/0/03/National_Basketball_Association_logo.svg/120px-National_Basketball_Association_logo.svg.png' style='height: 70px; width: auto; border-radius: 5px;'>
    </div>
    <div style='text-align: center; flex-grow: 1;'>
      <span style='font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: bold; text-decoration: underline;'>Salary Correlated Metric Trends</span><br>
      <span style='font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: bold;'>2019–25</span>
    </div>
  </div>"
)
gt(wide_summary) %>%
  cols_label(Stat = "Stat", `2019-20 Avg` = "2019–20 Avg", `2024-25 Avg` = "2024–25 Avg", `Overall Std. Dev` = "Overall St Dev", `Avg % Increase Per Year` = "% Increase/Yr", `IQR Trend` = "IQR Trend", `Std. Dev % Increase` = "St Dev % Increase", `SD Trend` = "St Dev Trend", `2024-25 Distribution` = "2024–25 Distribution") %>%
  gt_plt_sparkline(`IQR Trend`, same_limit = TRUE, type = "default", palette = c('black', 'black','blue','red','black')) %>%
  gt_plt_sparkline(`SD Trend`, same_limit = TRUE, type = "default", palette = c('black', 'black','blue','red','black')) %>%
  gt_plt_dist(`2024-25 Distribution`, type = "density", line_color = 'grey', fill_color = 'black') %>%
  tab_style(style = list(cell_text(align = "center", weight = "bold", decorate = "underline", size = 12)), locations = cells_column_labels(everything())) %>%
  tab_style(style = list(cell_text(align = "left", weight = "bold", size=12)), locations = cells_body(columns = Stat)) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(align = "right", size=12), locations = cells_body(c(-Stat))) %>%
  gt_add_divider(Stat, weight = px(1)) %>%
  tab_header(title = html(title_header))
```

#start model
```{r}
nba_data_25 <- nba_data_25 %>% mutate(Year = '2024-25', PIE = as.numeric(PIE)) %>% dplyr::select(PLAYER, Year, PIE, POSS, TEAM)
nba_data_24 <- nba_data_24 %>% mutate(Year = '2023-24', PIE = as.numeric(PIE)) %>% dplyr::select(PLAYER, Year, PIE, POSS, TEAM)
nba_data_23 <- nba_data_23 %>% mutate(Year = '2022-23', PIE = as.numeric(PIE)) %>% dplyr::select(PLAYER, Year, PIE, POSS, TEAM)
nba_data_22 <- nba_data_22 %>% mutate(Year = '2021-22', PIE = as.numeric(PIE)) %>% dplyr::select(PLAYER, Year, PIE, POSS, TEAM)
nba_data_21 <- nba_data_21 %>% mutate(Year = '2020-21', PIE = as.numeric(PIE)) %>% dplyr::select(PLAYER, Year, PIE, POSS, TEAM)
nba_data_20 <- nba_data_20 %>% mutate(Year = '2019-20', PIE = as.numeric(PIE)) %>% dplyr::select(PLAYER, Year, PIE, POSS, TEAM)
all_nba_data <- rbind(nba_data_25, nba_data_24, nba_data_23, nba_data_22, nba_data_21, nba_data_20) %>% rename(Player = PLAYER)
all_nba_data <- normalize_names(all_nba_data)

adv_selected1 <- all_pg_advanced_salaries %>%
  group_by(Player, Year) %>%
  slice_max(G, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(Player, Year, salary, TS., X3PAr, FTr, ORB., DRB., TRB., AST., STL., BLK., TOV., USG., OBPM, DBPM, BPM, Age)
shooting_selected1 <- all_pg_shooting %>%
  group_by(Player, Year) %>%
  slice_max(G, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(Player, Year, FG. = `FG%`, Dist., FGA.2p, FGA.0.3 = `FGA.0-3`, FGA.3.10 = `FGA.3-10`, 
         FGA.10.16 = `FGA.10-16`, FGA.16.3P = `FGA.16-3P`, FGA.3P, 
         FG.2p, FG.0.3 = `FG.0-3`, FG.3.10 = `FG.3-10`, FG.10.16 = `FG.10-16`, 
         FG.16.3P = `FG.16-3P`, FG.3P, FG.2P_ast, FG.3P_ast, Corner3PA., Corner3P.)

model_data1 <- all_nba_data %>%
  inner_join(adv_selected1, by = c("Player", "Year")) %>%
  inner_join(shooting_selected1, by = c("Player", "Year")) %>%
  unique() %>%
  mutate(across(.cols = -c(Player, Year, TEAM), .fns = ~ as.numeric(.)))
model_data1.1 <- model_data1 %>% drop_na()

set.seed(123)
n <- nrow(model_data1.1)
train_index <- sample(seq_len(n), size = 0.8 * n)
train_data <- model_data1.1[train_index, ]
test_data <- model_data1.1[-train_index, ]

model <- lm(salary~OBPM+Age*USG.+POSS+FGA.16.3P+FGA.2p+FTr+FG.3.10+FG.3P+FG.2P_ast+FG.2p+BLK.+TOV., data = train_data)
summary(model)

test_data$pred_salary <- predict(model, newdata = test_data)
mean(abs(test_data$salary - test_data$pred_salary))

vif(model)

#-- no outliers

influence <- influence.measures(model)
train_data$leverage <- hatvalues(model)
train_data$cooks_d <- cooks.distance(model)
train_data$std_resid <- rstandard(model)

leverage_cutoff <- 2 * (length(model$coefficients)) / nrow(train_data)
cooks_cutoff <- 4 / nrow(train_data)
train_data_clean <- train_data %>%
  filter(leverage < leverage_cutoff,
         cooks_d < cooks_cutoff,
         abs(std_resid) < 3)

model_clean <- lm(salary~OBPM+Age*USG.+POSS+FGA.16.3P+FGA.2p+FTr+FG.3.10+FG.3P+FG.2P_ast+FG.2p+BLK.+TOV., 
                  data = train_data_clean)

summary(model_clean)
vif(model_clean)
test_data$pred_salary_clean <- predict(model_clean, newdata = test_data)
mean(abs(test_data$salary - test_data$pred_salary_clean))

#-- ptiles w/wout outliers

model_data1.2 <- model_data1 %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(salary_ptile = percent_rank(salary)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Player, -TEAM, -Year, -salary)
n2 <- nrow(model_data1.2)
train_index2 <- sample(seq_len(n2), size = 0.8 * n2)
train_data2 <- model_data1.2[train_index2, ]
test_data2 <- model_data1.2[-train_index2, ]
model_ptile <- lm(salary_ptile~POSS+Age+USG.+DBPM+FGA.3.10+FG.3.10+BLK.+AST., data = train_data2)
summary(model_ptile)
test_data2$pred_salary_ptile <- predict(model_ptile, newdata = test_data2)
test_data2 <- test_data2 %>% mutate(pred_salary_ptile = percent_rank(pred_salary_ptile))
mean(abs(test_data2$salary_ptile - test_data2$pred_salary_ptile))

ggplot(test_data2, aes(x = salary_ptile, y = pred_salary_ptile_clean)) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "darkred", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Predicted vs Actual Salary Percentile",
       x = "Actual Salary Percentile",
       y = "Predicted Salary Percentile") +
  theme_minimal()

train_data2_diag <- train_data2 %>%
  mutate(
    leverage = hatvalues(model_ptile),
    cooks_d = cooks.distance(model_ptile),
    std_resid = rstandard(model_ptile)
  )
leverage_thresh <- 2 * (length(coef(model_ptile)) / nrow(train_data2_diag))
cooks_thresh <- 4 / nrow(train_data2_diag)
train_data2_clean <- train_data2_diag %>%
  filter(
    leverage < leverage_thresh,
    cooks_d < cooks_thresh,
    abs(std_resid) < 3,
  )

model_ptile_clean <- lm(salary_ptile ~ POSS + Age + USG. + DBPM + FGA.3.10 + FG.3.10 + BLK. + AST., 
                        data = train_data2_clean)
summary(model_ptile_clean)
test_data2$pred_salary_ptile_clean <- predict(model_ptile_clean, newdata = test_data2)
mean(abs(test_data2$salary_ptile - test_data2$pred_salary_ptile_clean))

#-- log salary and clean

model_data2 <- model_data1 %>% dplyr::select(-Player, -TEAM, -Year) %>% drop_na() %>% mutate(salary = log(salary))
n3 <- nrow(model_data2)
train_index3 <- sample(seq_len(n3), size = 0.8 * n3)
train_data3 <- model_data2[train_index3, ]
test_data3 <- model_data2[-train_index3, ]

model2 <- lm(salary ~ POSS + Age + USG. + DBPM + FGA.0.3 + ORB. + FGA.3.10 + Dist. + FTr + FG.3.10, data = train_data3)
summary(model2)

train_data3_diag <- train_data3 %>%
  mutate(
    leverage = hatvalues(model2),
    cooks_d = cooks.distance(model2),
    std_resid = rstandard(model2)
  )
leverage_thresh <- 2 * (length(coef(model2)) / nrow(train_data3_diag))
cooks_thresh <- 4 / nrow(train_data3_diag)
train_data3_clean <- train_data3_diag %>%
  filter(leverage < leverage_thresh,
         cooks_d < cooks_thresh,
         abs(std_resid) < 3)

model2_clean <- lm(salary ~ log(POSS) + Age * USG. + DBPM + FGA.0.3 + ORB. + FGA.3.10 + FG.3.10 + FTr+ Dist., data = train_data3_clean)
summary(model2_clean)
test_data3$pred_salary_clean <- predict(model2_clean, newdata = test_data3)
mean(abs(test_data3$salary - test_data3$pred_salary_clean))
```
